blocks.text: Kirchhoff ke qawaid (rules) circuit ke tajziye ke do bunyadi usool hain jo electrical circuits mein currents aur voltages maloom karne mein madad dete hain. Yeh khaas taur par aise pecheeda circuits ke tajziye ke liye mufeed hain jo Ohm ke qanoon aur series ya parallel jor se saada nahi kiye ja sakte.

blocks.title: Kirchhoff ka pehla qaida
blocks.text: Circuit mein kisi nuqte par milne wale tamam currents ka majmooa sifar hai: sum of I = 0 ... (9.43), is riwayat ke saath ke nuqte ki taraf aane wala current musbat aur nuqte se door jane wala manfi hai. Doosre lafzon mein, nuqte ki taraf behne wale tamam currents ka majmooa nuqte se door behne wale tamam currents ke majmooe ke barabar hai.

Ek nuqte A par milne wale chaar taar lein (Fig. 9.27). A mein aane wale currents I1 aur I2, aur door jane wale I3 aur I4 hain. Riwayat ke mutabiq I1 + I2 + (-I3) + (-I4) = 0, ya I1 + I2 = I3 + I4 ... (9.44). Kirchhoff ka pehla qaida, jise point rule bhi kehte hain, charge ki baqa (conservation of charge) ke qanoon ka izhar hai: agar kisi nuqte par charge ka koi sink ya source na ho to nuqte ki taraf behne wala kul charge us se door behne wale kul charge ke barabar hona chahiye. Node electric circuit ka woh nuqta hai jo do ya zyada shakhon (branches) ko jorta hai (For Your Information); jis node ka potential sifar liya jaye use datum node kehte hain (Do You Know).

blocks.alt: Chaar taarein, har ek mein resistor, nuqte A par milti hain. Teer: I1 (baen se) aur I2 (neeche baen se) A ki taraf; I3 (neeche daen) aur I4 (oopar daen) A se door.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.27: Kirchhoff ke pehle qaide ke mutabiq I1 + I2 = I3 + I4 (kitab ki Figure 9.27 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: A mein aane wale currents I1 aur I2 hain aur jane wale I3 aur I4, is liye I1 + I2 = I3 + I4 (charge ki baqa). Kitab ki caption 'I1 + I3 = I2 + I4' chhapti hai jo us ke apne text aur Eq. 9.44 ke khilaf hai; yahan durust rishta likha gaya hai.

Yeh kehta hai ke kisi band circuit ya loop mein voltage ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic majmooa sifar hona chahiye. Fig. 9.28 ka band circuit lein. Current I ki simt zyada emf wale cell par munhasir hai; maan lein E1, E2 se bara hai, to current ghari ki ulti simt (anticlockwise) behta hai. Mustaqil current musbat charges ke musalsal bahao ke barabar hai, aur voltage ki tabdeeli woh kaam hai jo unit musbat charge par ek nuqte se doosre tak jane mein ho, ya us ki hasil ki gayi ya khoi energy. Jab musbat charge Q cell E1 se kam (-) se zyada (+) potential ki taraf guzarta hai to energy E1 Q hasil karta hai. Cell E2 se zyada se kam potential ki taraf guzarte hue energy E2 Q khota hai. Resistor R1 se guzarte hue energy I R1 Q, aur R2 se I R2 Q khota hai. Aakhir charge E1 ke manfi terminal par pohanchta hai jahan se chala tha. Energy ki baqa ke qanoon se energy mein kul tabdeeli sifar hai: E1 Q - I R1 Q - E2 Q - I R2 Q = 0, ya E1 - I R1 - E2 - I R2 = 0 ... (9.45).

blocks.alt: Mustateel loop: oopar ki taar mein resistance R1 aur cell E1, baen taraf cell E2, neeche resistance R2. Darmiyan khamdaar teer I: current anticlockwise.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.28: Kirchhoff ke doosre qaide ke mutabiq E1 - IR1 - E2 - IR2 = 0 (kitab ki Figure 9.28 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: E1 bara hai, is liye current anticlockwise hai. E1 mein charge - se + jata hai (energy milti hai, +E1); E2 mein + se - (energy kho deta hai, -E2); R1 aur R2 mein current ki simt mein -IR1 aur -IR2. Majmooa sifar.

blocks.title: Kirchhoff ka doosra qaida
blocks.text: Band circuit mein potential ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic majmooa sifar hai. Yeh qaida electrical masail mein energy ki baqa ke qanoon ko bayan karne ka ek khaas tareeqa hai.
Is qaide ko pecheeda (complex) network ke tajziye mein lagane se pehle potential ki tabdeeliyan maloom karne ke qawaid achhi tarah samajh lena faida mand hai.

items: Agar emf ke source (cell) ko musbat se manfi terminal ki taraf paar karein to potential ki tabdeeli manfi (-E) hai. Ulti simt mein yeh musbat (+E) hai.
Agar resistor ko current ki simt mein paar karein to potential ki tabdeeli manfi (-IR) hai. Ulti simt mein yeh musbat (+IR) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke likhe hue qawaid (i) aur (ii) ulti alamaat dete hain: un ke mutabiq cell ko + se - ki taraf, aur resistor ko current ki simt mein, paar karne par tabdeeli musbat hai. Yeh ghalat hai: + se - jane par potential girta hai (-E), aur current ki simt mein resistor par bhi potential girta hai (-IR). Kitab ka apna For Your Information box, Example 9.10 aur hal karne ke tareeqe ka qadam (iv) bhi yahi sahi alamaat istemal karte hain.

blocks.caption: Potential ki tabdeeliyon ki alamaat (kitab ke box aur hal shuda misal ke mutabiq)
rows: Cell - se + ki taraf (kam se zyada potential)

blocks.title: Example 9.10
blocks.text: Fig. 9.29 ke circuit ki teen resistances mein currents nikalein: R1 = 10 ohm, R2 = 30 ohm, R3 = 15 ohm; E1 = 40 V, E2 = 60 V, E3 = 50 V (print mein 'R3 = 50 V'). Hal: loops abcda aur ebcfe lein, loop currents I1 aur I2 dono ghari ki simt (clockwise). Loop abcda: -E1 - I1 R1 - (I1 - I2) R2 + E2 = 0, to -40 - 10 I1 - 30 (I1 - I2) + 60 = 0, ya 4 I1 - 3 I2 = 2 A ... (i). Loop ebcfe: -E2 - (I2 - I1) R2 - I2 R3 + E3 = 0, to -60 - 30 (I2 - I1) - 15 I2 + 50 = 0, ya 6 I1 - 9 I2 = 2 A ... (ii). Hal karne par I1 = 2/3 A = 0.66 A aur I2 = 2/9 A = 0.22 A.

blocks.alt: Do loops wala circuit, oopar nuqte e, b, a aur neeche f, c, d. Teeno khari shaakhon mein resistor ke oopar cell: baen E3 aur R3, darmiyan E2 aur R2, daen E1 aur R1. Clockwise teer loop currents I2 (baen loop) aur I1 (daen loop). Qeematein: R1 = 10 ohm, R2 = 30 ohm, R3 = 15 ohm; E1 = 40 V, E2 = 60 V, E3 = 50 V.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.29 (kitab ki Figure 9.29 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein qeemat 'R3 = 50 V' chhapi hai; resistance volts mein nahi hoti aur R3 = 15 ohm pehle hi diya gaya hai. Text ke hal mein E3 = 50 V istemal hota hai, is liye yahan E3 = 50 V likha gaya hai. Darmiyani shaakh (R2) dono loops mein hai, is liye us mein current I1 - I2 hai.

Asal currents loop currents se milte hain. R1 mein current I1 = 2/3 A = 0.66 A, a se d ki taraf. R2 mein current I1 - I2 = 2/3 A - 2/9 A = 0.44 A, I1 ki simt mein, c se b ki taraf. R3 mein current I2 = 2/9 A = 0.22 A, f se e ki taraf. Loop abcda mein loop ka apna current I1 musbat aur ulat current I2 manfi liya jata hai; loop ebcfe mein ulat.
Circuit ke masail hal karne ka tareeqa

items: Loops is tarah chunein ke har resistance chune gaye loops mein kam az kam ek baar shamil ho.
Har loop mein loop current farz karein; tamam loop currents ek hi rukh mein hon, ya to clockwise ya anticlockwise.
Tamam chune gaye loops ki equations likhein; kisi hisse par voltage ki tabdeeli musbat hai agar kam se zyada potential ki taraf guzrein aur manfi agar zyada se kam ki taraf.
Na-maloom miqdaron ke liye yeh equations hal karein.

blocks.prompt: Poore circuit ke liye potential ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic majmooa sifar hai: yeh kis ka bayan hai (MCQ 9.9)? Kirchhoff ke qawaid bayan aur wazeh kijiye (comprehensive question 9.2).
blocks.explanation: Yeh Kirchhoff ka doosra qaida hai, option (d). Pehla qaida kehta hai ke kisi junction mein aane wale currents bahar jane wale currents ke barabar hain (sum of I = 0), kyunke charge baqi rehta hai. Doosra qaida kehta hai ke kisi bhi band loop mein emfs aur IR potential tabdeeliyon ka algebraic majmooa sifar hai, kyunke unit charge cells se jitni energy hasil karta hai utni resistors mein khota hai.

items: Pehla qaida (point rule, charge ki baqa): junction par sum of I = 0; I1 + I2 = I3 + I4 (9.44). Doosra qaida (loop rule, energy ki baqa): band loop mein potential tabdeeliyon ka algebraic majmooa = 0; E1 - IR1 - E2 - IR2 = 0 (9.45).
Alamaat: cell - se + par +E; current ke saath resistor -IR. Example 9.10: I1 = 0.66 A (R1), I2 = 0.22 A (R3), R2 mein 0.44 A. Tareeqa: diagram, loops chunna, ek rukh ke loop currents, equations, hal.
